S1:24.text: If there ſhalbe fiftie iuſt perſons in the citie, ſhal they periſh withal? and wilt thou ſpare that place for fiftie iuſt, if they be therin? †

S1:25.text: Be it farre from thee, that thou doe this thing, and that thou kil the iuſt with the wicked, and that the iuſt be in like caſe as the wicked, this is not beſeeming thee: which Iudgeſt al the earth, no thou wilt not do this iudgement.

S1:29.text: And againe he ſaid vnto him: But if fourtie shalbe found there, what wilt thou doe? He ſaid I wil not ſtrike it for fourties ſake.

S1:30.text: Lord, ſaith he, be not angrie I beſech thee, if I ſpeake what if thirtie shal be founde there? He anſwered I wil not doe it, if I shal find thirtie there.

S3:19.text: For I know that he wil commande his children, and his houſe after him that they kepe the way of the Lord, and doe iudge- ment and iuſtice: that for Abrahams ſake the Lord may bring to effect al the things that he hath ſpoken vnto him. Therfore ſaid our Lord. †

S3:21.text: I wil deſcend, and ſee whether they haue in acte accompliſhed the crye that is come to me: or whether it be not ſo, that I may know.

S3:29.text: And againe he ſaid vnto him: But if fourtie shalbe found there, what wilt thou doe? He ſaid I wil not ſtrike it for fourties ſake.

S3:30.text: Lord, ſaith he, be not angrie I beſech thee, if I ſpeake what if thirtie shal be founde there? He anſwered I wil not doe it, if I shal find thirtie there.

S6:12.text: Who laughed ſecretly ſaying: After I am waxen old, and my Lord is an old one ſhal I giue my ſelfe to pleaſure

S6:19.text: For I know that he wil command his children, and his houſe after him that they keep the way of the Lord, & doe iudgement and iuſtice: that for Abrahams ſake the Lord may bring to effect al the things that he hath ſpoken vnto him. Therfore ſaid our Lord

S6:20.text: The cry of Sodome and Gomorre is multiplied, and their ſinne is aggrauated exceedingly.

S6:22.text: And they turned themſelues from thence, and went their way to Sodome but Abraham as yet ſtood before our Lord.

S6:23.text: And approaching he ſaid: What! wilt thou deſtroy the iuſt with the wicked 24.(c)

S6:27.text: And Abraham anſwered and ſaid: Becauſe I haue once begun, I wil ſpeake to my Lord, wheras I am duſt and aſhes.

S6:31.text: Becauſe, ſaith he, I haue once begun, I wil ſpeake to my Lord: What if twentie ſhal be found there? He ſaid: I wil not deſtroy it for twenties ſake. 32...I

S6:33.text: And our Lord departed after that he ceaſed to ſpeake vnto. Abraham: and Abraham returned into his place-
